item.title: Has an orchard! Field Farm. Ten acres in Michigan.$299,500
item.description: I love this property! That barn is great and who wouldn’t want their own orchard! Field Farm was built in 1893. It is located on ten acres in Hillsdale, Michigan. The house features wood floors, wainscoting, stenciled floors, chair rails, crown moulding and exposed beams. The house feels a bit dark, but better lighting would help. There is a large barn on the property, a greenhouse and an orchard. Five bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,925 square feet. $299,500 Contact Lori Rubley with Century 21 Aff

item.title: New Hampshire’s most expensive old house listing! Knollwood, C. 1900. $9,999,000
item.description: Welcome to New Hampshire’s most expensive old house listing! This one has a lot of history! It has only had two owners, one being the founder of Sheraton Hotels. President William Howard Taft used it as his occasional summer White House. Known as Knollwood, it was built in 1900. It is located on 104 acres in Dublin, New Hampshire. item.title: Pretty area! Short drive to the mountains! Over an acre in North Carolina. $169,900
item.description: This is a nice house in a pretty area! Just a short drive to the mountains! The house was built in 1945. It is located on 1.24 acres in Lenoir, North Carolina. The house features wood floors, exposed beams, built-in bookshelves and a lot of natural light. There is a detached storage shed with carport. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,318 square feet. $169,900 Contact Rhonda Walker with Walker Real Estate Servicers: rhonda.realtor.lenoir@gmail.com From the Zillow listing: A SWEET STORY-BOOK HO

item.title: Love the built-in corner cabinets! Pretty area! C. 1931 in Virginia. $255,000
item.description: I love those built-in corner cabinets! This is a pretty area of Virginia. It’s not far from Hungry Mother State Park which has great hiking! The house was built in 1931. It is located on .43 acre in Marion, Virginia. The house features two covered porches, original wood floors, built-in corner cabinets, phone nook, original millwork, built-in bookshelves, laundry room and a spacious kitchen. item.title: Diamond in the Rough! Over 5,000 sf! One acre in Mississippi. $224,500
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough to me! Wish they showed more of the pool. And this is a big house with over 5,000 square feet of living space! The house was built in 1925. It is located on 1.15 acres in West Point, Mississippi. The house features a front porch, large back deck, original wood floors, french doors, transom windows, wide baseboards, crown moulding, built-in bookshelves and a spacious kitchen. There is an in-ground pool and a storage shed on the property. Six bedrooms,

item.title: Original details inside! Circa 1940 in Mississippi. $104,000
item.description: This house has original details inside! The home was built in the early 1900’s. It is located on .42 acre in Crystal Springs, Mississippi. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, baseboards, crystal chandelier, chair rails, spacious kitchen and wainscoting. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,827 square feet. $104,000 Contact Lisa Bourgoyne with Epique: 601-954-4873 From the Zillow listing: Sitting on a corner lot this house in Crystal Springs MS is ready for its new homeown

item.title: Unique property with a waterfall! Over two acres in Missouri. $359,900
item.description: This is a unique property with a waterfall! I wonder if it was an old mill. It has that look, and especially with the limestone wall inside on the bottom floor. The house was built in 1938. It is located on 2.4 acres in Eureka, Missouri. The house has been updated and features a updated kitchen, murphy bed, breakfast room and a large deck. item.title: Montana living! Main house and multiple cabins. Two acres with apple trees. $485,000
item.description: Montana living! This property includes a main house and multiple cabins. There are even apple trees. The house was built in 1895. It is located on 2.4 acres in Sheridan, Montana. The main house has been updated and has knotty pine, claw foot tub, wood stove and a spacious kitchen. The property also includes a guest cabin, dry cabin, homesteaders cabin and two shops. The main house has two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,324 square feet. $485,000 Contact Dawn Buttrey with Resolute Roots Realty: 406

item.title: Wide floor boards! Deacon Chesley House, C. 1792. Over three acres in New Hampshire. $475,000
item.description: Love those wide floor boards! Known as the Deacon Chesley House. It was built in 1792. It is located on 3.42 acres in Tamworth, New Hampshire. The house features wide plank floor boards, exposed beams, wainscoting, large fireplace and built-in bookshelves. There is a detached carriage house on the property. item.title: Former Cemetery Gatehouse! C. 1896 in New York. $339,900
item.description: Love the exterior of this home! It was the former gate house for the Forest Hill Cemetery. The house was built by Enock Curtis in 1896. It is located on .4 acre in Fredonia, New York. This sandstone house is featured in a book, Architecture in Fredonia. The house features a sandstone exterior, a covered front porch, wood floors, updated kitchen and original windows. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,980 square feet. $339,900 Contact Kara Saletta with Midtown Realty: 716-467-3484 From the Zillo
